rules.description: Lightroom Mode, a -> shift+a, s/d -> left/right arrows, v -> command+v.
Map Left Option plus h/j/k/l to Arrows
Multitouch wsad: w->UpPage, s->DownPage, a->left, b->right
Multitouch actions: x-Command+w; f->Command-Click; c->Click, r->Command+r
(Atom, CKII, EUIV, iTerm, muCommander, PyCharm, VSCode, VSCodium, WebStorm, AndroidStudio) Function keys work as fn keys
Mac OSX: Use Function Keys in Supported Apps, else use Media Keys
